entities.name: Banderuola
observations: Drosophila Banderuola (Bnd) was identified in an in-vivo live-imaging RNAi screen for disrupted Numb segregation in sensory organ precursor cells.
Bnd inhibition affects cell polarization, spindle orientation, and asymmetric protein localization in Drosophila neural precursors.

entities.name: Discs-large
observations: Drosophila discs-large (Dlg) is a membrane-associated tumor suppressor that acts with Banderuola to establish opposing cortical domains during asymmetric cell division.

entities.name: Asymmetric cell division
observations: In Drosophila sensory organ precursor and neural precursor cells, Banderuola perturbation disrupts polarity, spindle orientation, and asymmetric protein localization.

entities.name: PMID:25088559
observations: Primary 2014 study titled The conserved discs-large binding partner Banderuola regulates asymmetric cell division in Drosophila.
Bnd and dlg perturbations show genetic enhancement; combined knockdown causes massive brain tumors, supporting a functional Bnd-Dlg interaction in polarity and tumor suppression.
